text: Bulgaria is a driver of the processes for building connectivity in Europe, stated President Iliana Iotova at a forum in Yerevan (04.05.2026 16:37)

Connectivity is not just a strategic choice. It is a guarantee for our common security – from the economy to defense. Bulgaria is not only an active partner but also a driver of these processes, stated Vice President Iliana Iotova during the discussions at the Eighth Summit of the European Political Community, which is being held in the Armenian capital, Yerevan. This was reported by the press secretariat of the head of state. Nearly 50 heads of state and government are participating in the forum under the theme “Building the Future: Security and Stability in Europe.” The European Political Community aims to foster political dialogue and cooperation to strengthen the security, stability, and prosperity of the European continent.

It is high time that national projects find their place in our shared geographical and economic connectivity. Southeast Europe is a strategic bridge between our continent, Asia, and the Middle East. Times of crisis open up new opportunities, Yotova pointed out, as cited in the announcement. In her speech, the Vice President emphasized projects related to the energy and transport connectivity of the Old Continent, in which Bulgaria is an active participant.

Global conflicts have taught us the hard way that we must develop our energy independence and diversify our energy sources, Yotova also stated, emphasizing that the gas interconnector between Greece and Bulgaria plays a key role in diversification.

The head of state emphasized that Bulgaria was one of the first countries to expand the capacity of its gas storage facilities after the 2022 gas crisis. She highlighted the significance of one of the largest-scale projects – the Vertical Gas Corridor, which will connect Greece, Bulgaria, Romania, and Hungary. The Bulgarian part of the project is almost completed.

We are working on expanding the infrastructure for renewable energy, especially along the Black Sea coast, as well as with solar systems, Iliana Iotova also said, as quoted in the press release. She pointed out that Bulgaria is one of the largest and most consistent supporters of clean and safe nuclear energy, while the European Union is only now reviewing its position on the matter.

The President highlighted the importance of transport connectivity. We insist on accelerating the construction of Corridor 8, which will connect Bulgaria, North Macedonia, and Albania – in practice, the Adriatic with the Black Sea. This is an important project not only economically, but also from the point of view of security, not only for the region but for all of Europe, Yotova pointed out. She emphasized that these projects are important for the integration of the Western Balkan countries, as they will contribute to bilateral connectivity, as well as to transport arteries throughout Europe. The President also called for the development of the Trans-European Transport Network – a large-scale project for the construction of infrastructure for different types of transport in Europe.

Iliana Iotova also emphasized the importance of the Trans-Caspian Transport Corridor, which will contribute to the connectivity between Europe and Asia. The Head of State highlighted how important it is to build another bridge over the Danube River and to complete the transport link between Silistra and Călărași.

In his statement, the President pointed out that Bulgaria has strengthened the role of its ports on the Black Sea. These are projects important not only for the economy but also for the security of the continent, said Yotova.

Bulgaria is building industrial zones around major cities for investment and regional supply security. The President highlighted Bulgaria's strong positions in the development of new technologies, cybersecurity, and artificial intelligence. Bulgaria is one of the six countries selected by the European Commission for the construction of an AI gigafactory.

The head of state also emphasized the importance of the European Union's Multiannual Financial Framework. It is extremely important for economic projects, regional connectivity and development to preserve the cohesion policy, and Bulgaria will firmly insist on this, Iotova emphasized.

"The Vertical Gas Corridor has strategic importance for Europe's energy security. In addition to the economic benefits, it also has political significance in a time of serious geopolitical divisions and military conflicts," stated President Iliana Iotova earlier today.
